request.raw_text: Add a sliding switch on the bottom to provide a convenient on and off function
functional_intention_words: provide a convenient on and off function

aim.primary_aim: The final model should include a bottom-located sliding switch that provides a convenient on and off function.

functional_design_intentions.name: On/off control
functional_design_intentions.description: Provide a user-operable control for selecting the on and off states.

functional_design_intentions.name: Convenient operation
functional_design_intentions.description: Make the on and off control convenient to operate from the bottom of the model.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: sliding switch on the bottom of the model

targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve non-targeted geometry and existing functionality except for changes necessary to accommodate the bottom sliding switch.

geometry.description: A sliding switch exists on the bottom of the final model.

functions.name: On/off selection
functions.description: The sliding switch provides a convenient means of selecting the on and off states.

behaviors.name: Sliding state change
behaviors.description: The switch responds to sliding input by permitting selection between on and off states.

validation_criteria.description: A sliding switch feature is present on the bottom of the model.
The switch provides selectable on and off functionality.
Sliding actuation permits changing between the on and off states.
Non-targeted model geometry and existing functionality remain unchanged except where accommodation of the switch requires modification.

unresolved_requirements.description: The exact position and orientation of the switch within the bottom area are not specified.
candidate_interpretations: Place the switch at a convenient accessible location on the bottom.
Place the switch at a location dictated by internal component or enclosure constraints.

unresolved_requirements.description: The switch dimensions, travel, state positions, and mounting interface are not specified.
candidate_interpretations: Size and configure the feature for an existing switch component.
Create a generic sliding switch representation compatible with the available bottom geometry.

unresolved_requirements.description: It is unclear whether the requested geometry represents a complete switch component or only an externally accessible sliding actuator.
candidate_interpretations: Add a complete sliding switch component.
Add only the external sliding actuator and its required interface.

unresolved_requirements.description: The system or circuit whose state is controlled by the switch is not identified.
candidate_interpretations: Control the primary power state of the modeled product.
Control another existing on/off function within the product.
